beats.cf-0-001: You stand alone in the soot-choked engine shed of Ashgate, feeling the heavy iron thrum of the Marrowbone beneath your boots while Hesper Quill remains missing.
beats.cf-0-021: You haul the heavy brass regulator forward as the signals drop, dragging the Marrowbone out of the depot and onto the empty rails of the Ashen Steppe.

cf-0-002.situation: You must prepare the idling locomotive and settle your business in the yards before the boiler pressure forces your hand.

chains.cf-0-002/0: You search Hesper Quill's empty locker for hidden notes, testing your CUNNING against a watchful union clerk to secure a greasy spare regulator valve.
chains.cf-0-002/1: You crawl beneath the firebox to fix a leaking injector nozzle, testing your MECHANICS against the searing heat to earn a heavy copper wrench.
chains.cf-0-002/2: You negotiate with the water-seller for enough grey water to fill the tender, testing your CUNNING against his lies to acquire a skin of oil.
chains.cf-0-002/3: You question the nervous ticket-widow about who was seen leaving Hesper's office, testing your CUNNING against her silence to learn a secret signal-pass.
